name: io.github.JacekSmi/PolishOpenData
title: Polish Open Data (unofficial)
description: Polish registers: KRS, VAT, bank checks, parcels, geocoding, property prices (RCN), local statistics (GUS BDL), optional REGON and CEIDG.

environmentVariables.name: POLISHOPENDATA_OFFLINE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for the prepared VAT whitelist flat-file indexes used by check_vat_bank_account_offline (a local disk, not a network share). Default: PolishOpenData/BialaListaOffline under the user's local application data folder.

environmentVariables.name: POLISHOPENDATA_REGON_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own free GUS BIR key (regon_bir@stat.gov.pl); enables the lookup_regon tool. Stays on your machine.

environmentVariables.name: POLISHOPENDATA_CEIDG_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own free CEIDG API token (a personal JWT from biznes.gov.pl, e-service 00_9999_00); enables the lookup_ceidg tool. Stays on your machine.

environmentVariables.name: POLISHOPENDATA_BDL_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own free GUS BDL API key (from the BDL registration); raises the rate limits of find_statistical_unit, search_statistics and get_statistics, which work without it.
